comment: Henley is plenty accurate for Harbour Town, has won a recent Signature Event and enters off a serious run at the green jacket on Sunday. Don't expect him to slow down this week.
Every year he is in the mix at Harbour Town. After cashing T12 at the Masters following T7 at the Valspar Championship, form is not the issue. I am hoping he breaks me out of a slump!
This is a prime spot for Fleetwood. He wasn’t directly in contention at Augusta, so he has a little more left in the mental/emotional tank at a place that naturally suits him.
Paying little mind to the Masters result. Fitzpatrick is playing extraordinary golf and won't lack motivation or energy to win on the course he spent plenty of time on as a youngster.
Fresh off his best career finish in a major, the accurate driver returns to the tight corridors of Harbour Town where he’s secured three straight top 20s.
